title: Content page crashes after a frontend deployment removes an old lazy chunk
original_report: TypeError: Failed to fetch dynamically imported module: https://localos.pro/assets/ContentPage-DkJURCGd.js when opening the Content tab.
discovery_scope: Production HTTP responses and application logs
Frontend deployment asset retention and integrity checks
expected: Opening the Content tab loads the current route, including when an already-open browser tab references a chunk removed by a newer deployment.
actual: The old ContentPage chunk returned HTTP 404 and ContentPage had no route-load recovery, causing an unhandled dynamic-import failure.
environment: LocalOS production, Vite 7, React lazy routes, Docker/Flask runtime
reproduction: A focused contract test reads the real App.tsx ContentPage lazy route and requires the existing one-shot loadRouteWithRecovery mechanism.
failure_signal: Before the fix, the contract test failed specifically because the ContentPage lazy import bypassed loadRouteWithRecovery.
root_cause: ContentPage was imported directly while DashboardLayout and SettingsPage already used one-shot recovery. After deployment removed the old hashed chunk, ContentPage could not refresh onto the current entry bundle.
fix_summary: Wrapped only the ContentPage lazy import in the existing loadRouteWithRecovery helper with the route label контента.
why_causal: The wrapper catches a rejected or timed-out ContentPage import, performs one cache-busting navigation, and prevents reload loops through the existing session guard.

reproduction_files.summary: Focused route recovery contract approved at Gate 1.

fix_files.summary: ContentPage now uses the existing one-shot lazy-route recovery approved at Gate 2.

checks.name: Regression test
checks.detail: Same command changed from 1 failed to 1 passed.

checks.name: Related frontend tests
checks.detail: 3 tests passed, including dynamic asset integrity fixtures.

checks.name: Asset closure
checks.detail: 116 reachable JavaScript assets validated before deployment; deployed assets validated again.

checks.name: Authenticated browser pass
checks.detail: The production Content page rendered one Контент heading and no console errors.

limitations: The production smoke verifies the current build; the red-to-green test verifies the stale-chunk recovery wiring without deleting a live production asset.
residual_risks: Other directly imported lazy routes still do not use the recovery helper and should be considered separately rather than bundled into this fix.
notes: The deployment merged the new build into the existing dist so older hashed chunks were not deleted.
No database, backend API, publication, or customer data changed.
